# SaltWatch Card 0.6.0 beta 1

This beta keeps the automatic SaltWatch setup while opening the card to other
water-softener integrations through individual entity mapping.

## What changed

- Added a **Data source** choice to the graphical editor: **SaltWatch device**
  continues to use strict, rename-safe automatic discovery, while **Other
  device** exposes entity mapping.
- Made only the numeric salt-level entity required for other devices.
- Added optional mappings for the low-salt threshold, device status, estimated
  days until low salt, forecast status, and forecast details.
- Added a fixed low-salt threshold that defaults to 20% when another
  integration does not provide a threshold entity.
- Derived Good and Low salt states automatically when no status entity is
  mapped.
- Hidden forecast display choices when no forecast entity is available.
- Directed the default more-info action to the mapped salt-level entity.
- Added English and German editor copy and expanded the configuration guide.

## Compatibility

- Existing SaltWatch configurations using only `device_id` continue to work
  without changes.
- Manual YAML configurations infer the new entity-mapping source when
  `level_entity` is present, so an explicit `source` option is optional.
- Automatic discovery remains strict and still requires all six entities from
  the latest official SaltWatch firmware.

## Validation

- 53 unit tests passed.
- 45 browser tests passed across desktop and mobile profiles; one desktop-only
  mobile-scroll test was skipped as intended.
- The production TypeScript and Vite build passed.
